About Axis
Mental wellness through the three pillars
Axis helps you look after your mental health through three pillars of wellness: movement, nutrition, and sleep and recovery. It’s built on research about how the brain and body work together, and it’s made for anyone caring for their mental wellbeing, including people living with mental health conditions.
Axis offers education and self-care support, not diagnosis or treatment. If you’re struggling, the Crisis tab connects you to free help at any time.

Axis provides education, not medical advice.
